bullets.text: Rising UK Salaries - Median annual pay for all employees is now £32,890, reflecting a 4.1% increase.
Tax Deadlines Matter - Staying on top of tax dates helps avoid fines and manage cash flow effectively.
HR Leaders Under Pressure - 71% of HR leaders report increased workloads, highlighting the need for strategic adaptation.
Emotional Labour Risks - Managing emotions during client interactions can impact mental health, especially with MTD changes.
